notes.title: New Version of Persona5: The Phantom X Now Available
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/e64aa008d7ba4a2d21b5eb56f010917071a3cb1b.png"]

SEGA Corporation has released Version 2.0 of Persona5: The Phantom X ("P5X"). To celebrate our first major update, we’re giving away items including Meta Jewels, which can be used for Contracts (gacha) and more.

 

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/J-TPzn6V8Ow?si=mSsAsbwtI0Fo0eIe"][/dynamiclink]

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Z1EGITqqK68?si=RMbwaCJpMu6ZdhzY"][/dynamiclink]

We've also got some brand-new promotional videos showing off the charm of this ultimate school-life RPG. Take a look!

 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061570"][/dynamiclink]


◆ Synopsis of Chapter 3: Unconditional Love

“When did I abandon my true self?”

The Protagonist has awakened the power of his other self, his Persona, and become a Phantom Thief.  He forms a band of Phantom Thieves who are also Persona users to save innocent people from evildoers who evade justice, stealing their distorted desires and changing their hearts.  As the Phantom Thieves grow increasingly famous among the public, a mysterious new teacher is appointed at the Protagonist’s school. The group remains on high alert as this figure lurks the school grounds and manipulates the students.  Meanwhile, Riko Tanemura of the Disciplinary Committee begins to notice the school's gradual distortions and questions what is truly happening...

 [img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-2ec015b53ceebfadc55c7daa6403d03a-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"]

[img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-c32be5d4351835a7948735e379a38078-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"]

[img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-c5a0bb1f48e98fc7f998bf34b4c68205-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"]

[img src="https://prcdn.freetls.fastly.net/release_image/5397/6758/5397-6758-10ea6cecef485c1fd5f0d45c0fb28a89-1500x844.jpg?width=1950&height=1350&quality=85%2C65&format=jpeg&auto=webp&fit=bounds&bg-color=fff"]

◆Special Website for Ver. 2.0 Now Live!

　The special site is jam-packed with information on exciting new content, including the latest addition to the Main Story and the new neighborhood, Kichijoji. That’s not all! Information about the “Real Kichijoji (Tokyo, Japan) Collabs” and other real-world events will be released on the site in the future. Give it a read now, and keep it bookmarked for future updates!

 

Ver.2.0 Special Site 

https://persona5x.com/lp/



New version now available (with lots of loot to celebrate)!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/a5b5efec9a3a5a461eafad22b7b84fd0fe2c3a71.png"]

Log in to the game for 7 days by Oct 22, 2025 6:59 PM (PDT) to receive 20 Platinum Tickets (usable for certain Contracts/gacha) and 20 Platinum Milicoins (usable for certain Arms Deals). In addition, you’ll also receive 60 Phantom Thief Cognitite Shards, a new item that can Awaken 5★ Phantom Thieves such as Ren Amamiya, Yui, and Minami Miyashita, along with 1,000 Meta Jewels.

 

 

◆Comeback: 5★ Phantom Thief Ren Amamiya Returns!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/e9a5ce898fe5ef44a1dd721abb608ede52fc2286.png"]The 5★ Phantom Thief Ren Amamiya makes a Comeback to Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts: The Phantom Magician, and the Ren Amamiya-only 5★ weapon Phoenix Dagger will be featured again in Most Wanted for Arms Deals: Silent Pistol. Don’t miss this chance to recruit Ren Amamiya to your team!

 

 

◆Main Story Chapter 3: Unconditional Love Phase 1 released!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/1a5ed4dcb6d77944dfe62825f8185947cb647b57.jpg"]

Main Story Chapter 3: Unconditional Love Synopsis

At Kokatsu Academy, where the protagonist is enrolled, an educational consultant arrives with plans to reform the school’s policies.

Advocating a modern sense of “righteousness,” the consultant sets about improving the academy, but over time, the relationship between teachers and students begins to warp, and the school slowly transforms into something unsettling.

Riko Tanemura, an exceptional student and chair of the disciplinary committee, while being swept up in the “distortions born of righteousness” brought about by these reforms, gradually starts to perceive the strange changes taking hold.

 

How will the protagonist, Riko, and their allies stand against the “false righteousness” of an enemy who no one else recognizes as evil...?

 

▼Riko Tanemura (Code name: Wind) joins the group in Chapter 3.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/9577400f0f7e4786e9cfbbb1756ba58f8d7b9e08.jpg"]

 A support character who acts as the party’s commander and strategist, leading them to land flashy All-Out Attacks.

Even when not targeting an enemy’s Weakness, she can lower the enemy’s Down Points, and at the start of battle, she boosts the entire party’s HP, Attack, and Defense. She also possesses the ability to increase All-Out Attack damage by as much as 60%.

 

 

▼Character Introduction Movie

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gC8onJHoaEs"][/dynamiclink]

▼Character Skills Spotlight Movie

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZVevRsWS_Zk"][/dynamiclink]

◆Chapter 3: Unconditional Love Release Event!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/071d8abd0a3df4a4a705c74b9bafd9cdd67ed394.png"]

Play the new content added in Ver. 2.0 and complete goals to earn up to 1,280 Meta Jewels, as well as the event-exclusive item Mizuhiki Knots and other rewards. Collect Mizuhiki Knots to get the Riko Tanemura-only 4★ weapon Red Plum Blossom as well as the materials needed to fully upgrade it.

 

Duration: Until 6:59 PM on Oct 22, 2025 (PDT)

 

◆Addition of Kichijoji Area  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/872d7760ab5fd7774a2018d9ab8b8f778c1eed7a.png"]

A new area called Kichijoji has been added alongside Chapter 3 of the Main Story. This new area brings more ways to enjoy city life, such as new part-time jobs, as well as the chance to meet new characters and learn their stories.



◆New 5★ Phantom Thief: Ayaka Sakai!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/3b7a2d538f66babd416a67a65a093f5406de14ca.jpg"]

The new 5 ★Phantom Thief Ayaka Sakai will be featured in Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts, where the appearance rate for certain Phantom Thieves is increased. An exclusive weapon can be obtained through Arms Deals: Silent Pistol.

 

Most Wanted Phantom Idol Contracts: Dazzling Encore

Duration: Until 6:59 PM on Oct 8, 2025 (PDT)

 

▼Most Wanted Phantom Thief: 5★ Ayaka Sakai (Code Name: Chord)

Specializing in single-target buffs, she can turn an ally into a Costar, granting them an attack power boost, as well as significantly strengthening that ally’s Highlight effect. She's able to instantly activate an ally's Highlight, ignoring the Highlight Gauge and cooldown times, and significantly increase the damage dealt by that Highlight.

Plus, she can pump up the Gauge's fill rate, allowing Highlights to be activated at a quicker tempo.

 

 

▼Character Introduction Movie

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OtHae_5vj8k"][/dynamiclink]

▼Character Skills Spotlight Movie

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pLdgp2uOp1g"][/dynamiclink]

▼Ayaka Sakai's Synergy Story added!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/78b3a94097f4abcb5a5aaf91ded8d1833e50d606.png"]

The Synergy character interaction feature has been updated with a new story for Ayaka Sakai. Depending on your choices, you might even have a chance to date her! We hope you enjoy the story.

 

◆New Feature to Earn Items: Tasks

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621326/eea0ae2ea1586362f94339fad8d2b70809cdae28.png"]

Once your Player Level reaches 20, you’ll be able to use the Tasks feature, where you can send eligible allies to complete Tasks and receive rewards after a set amount of time. There are different types of requests, such as daily and weekly, with different time requirements and rewards. Use this feature to get Meta Jewels, Thief's Cognitite Shards, and maybe even something special from an exclusive Task...

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.06/1.07
notes.notes:
The latest patch has been released for Persona 3 Reload, which was released on 2/2/2024, and Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass, downloadable content that was released on 3/12/2024. Please see below for details:

Persona 3 Reload

 The “Change Battle BGM” function has been expanded to allow different BGMs to be set for “Change Normal Battle BGM” and “Change Boss Battle BGM”.
 By registering any BGMs to “Favorite BGM” and then selecting “Favorite”, the registered music will be played randomly.
 The default song is now also subject to random playback.

Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass

 Added “Episode Aigis”, which depicts the story after the main story is completed. Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass is required to play.

※The update patch will be applied automatically when the game is launched.

Thank you for your continued support of Persona 3 Reload!

notes.title: Persona 3 Reload release date, trailers, and gameplay
notes.notes:
When is the Persona 3 Reload release date? The Shin Megami Tensei spin-off might be over 25 years old, but it was Persona 3 that really put Atlus's RPG series on the map. Its social life mechanics were the new unique hook, providing a palette-cleanser from its relentless turn-based RPG fights and procedurally generated dungeons.
Finally, Persona 3 Reload has arrived on PC, giving the full and uncompromised experience of the original RPG game for the first time. Check out our Persona 3 Reload review if you want to know more. Here are all the details surrounding the P3 Reload release date, including gameplay changes, trailers, and news about any previously available expansion features.
